text:
**Version 2.4 release notes**

This update makes the app quicker to open and more stable, and you can now use it offline.

**Offline mode**
The app now works without an internet connection. You can keep using it on a plane, in a subway tunnel or anywhere the signal is weak. Once you reconnect, it carries on from where you stopped.

**Faster startup**
We changed how the app launches. It used to take 3.4 seconds to start and now takes 1.9, which cuts your wait by about 44% every time you open it.

**Crash fixes**
We fixed 12 crashes in this release, so the app should close unexpectedly less often and run more smoothly. Many of these fixes came from crash reports you sent us. Thank you.

**Android 8 no longer supported**
Starting with 2.4, the app needs Android 9 or later. That applies to this update and to future ones. To check your version, open Settings on your device and go to "About phone."

Thanks for using the app, and enjoy the update.
